advancements.wushiwuzhong.unlock.title: Star Gatherer
advancements.wushiwuzhong.unlock.descrip: Obtain a Nether Star to unlock the Wushiwuzhong recipe.
advancements.wushiwuzhong.start_or_end.d: 恭喜你，你走到了这一步，后面是一眼望不到头的路程，你还记得你的起点吗？
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.intro2: What is eternity? What is eternal silence?
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.intro3: Everything, all of it, is yours to decide.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.intro4: I am only a very weak sword.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.intro5: I have no beginning of existence, and no end of vanishing.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.break: Left-click a block: hardness ignored, broken instantly, drops go straight to your inventory.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.purge: Hold right-click for 1 tick: hostile mobs lose their rendering, their i-frames and their entity itself, while the 1.8 sword-block stance is kept.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.strike: Left-click any living thing: i-frames cleared every tick, Float.MAX_VALUE void damage, then /kill, then health forced to zero, then deathTime pinned to the maximum.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.immortal: Kept in inventory: no harm can touch you, no knockback can move you, your data is restored every tick, and even Remove-type erasure gets pulled back.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.bind: Bound: never breaks, never dropped, Q cannot throw it away, cannot be taken, and your inventory cannot be opened by anyone else.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.bless: While carried: creative flight, +50% movement speed, no attack cooldown, immunity to negative effects, no hunger loss, particle-free infinite night vision, and an OP that cannot be taken away.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.recipe: Obtain a Nether Star and the recipe unlocks in your recipe book.
tooltip.wushiwuzhong.slot: Craft anything with it: the sword is not consumed and the result comes out as 64; Shift + T clears the mob blacklist.
